# TecnoMart (Hyderabad, India)

> TecnoMart is an authorized retail tech store and premium product catalogue located in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. TecnoMart specializes in brand-new smartphones (Apple, Samsung, OnePlus, Google), authorized laptops (MacBooks, ASUS ROG, Dell XPS, Lenovo Legion, HP), custom water-cooled ARGB gaming rigs, certified Grade-A+ refurbished devices, genuine computer accessories, and certified same-day hardware repairs.

## Business Model
- **Website Role**: Product Catalogue & Lead Generation / Direct Consultation
- **Primary Enquiry & Booking Channel**: WhatsApp (+91 9010667726) & In-Store Visit
- **Physical Flagship Store**: H.No. 8-2-293/82/A/1287, Road No. 36, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana - 500033
- **Local Express Delivery**: Same-day 3–4 hour doorstep delivery across Hyderabad & Secunderabad
- **Payment & Checkout**: Offline in-store payment or confirmed directly via official WhatsApp invoice; no anonymous online cart checkout.
